name: Dream Education Knowledge Relationship Schema

relationship_types.prerequisite: Knowledge that should normally be understood first
relationship_types.builds_on: Knowledge that extends or develops another concept
relationship_types.part_of: A concept that belongs to a larger topic or domain
relationship_types.related_to: Concepts connected without a strict prerequisite relationship
relationship_types.application_of: A practical use of another concept
relationship_types.deeper_than: A more advanced treatment of related knowledge

rules: Every referenced knowledge id must exist in the global knowledge index
Prerequisite relationships must have a clear educational justification
Relationships must not be invented without evidence or educational reasoning
Proposed relationships must be distinguishable from verified relationships
Existing knowledge records must never be overwritten when relationships are added
